name: Westshore Electronics

about:
Westshore Electronics was founded in 2003 in Holland, Michigan. The company began as an engineering-focused operation providing electronic and mechanical design alongside software development, aiming to help customers move from concept to production.

Today the firm operates as a single-source electronics manufacturer, offering double-sided surface-mount assembly, flexible and metal-core PCB assembly, through-hole and mixed-technology builds, automated selective wave soldering, microcontroller programming, and full functional testing. Its equipment handles fine-pitch placement down to 01005 packages and ball-grid-array components, and it provides conformal coating, cable assemblies, and finished-goods box builds. The shop supports IPC Class 2 and 3 work and runs PPAP-capable processes.

Westshore serves small and mid-tier manufacturers in the medical, industrial-controls, durable-goods, and inspection-lighting sectors. Customers typically need embedded control systems, high-density circuit boards, LED PCBAs, instrument lighting, and electromechanical controls, and the company manages component sourcing and supply-chain logistics alongside design and production.

The company emphasizes a quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015, reinforced by on-site IPC training, a proprietary Track-Trace-Control system, and risk-mitigation tools such as PFMEA, PPAP, first-article inspection, and 8D problem solving. Its stated differentiation is the ability to act as a full-lifecycle electronics partner from ideation through volume production.
